get.description: Returns all line items for a capital planning project.

parameters.name: snapshot_id
parameters.description: When set, returns the stored data from the given completed snapshot instead of the live plan. The response shape is identical to the live plan.

percentage.description: Markup rate when amount_type is percentage — "10.0000" means 10%.

calculated_total.description: Read-only. For percentage rows this is derived from the sum of the non-percentage rows and is never stored.

parent_remaining.description: The parent project's remaining amount, in the company currency: planned amount minus job-to-date costs minus forecasts for the current month and later. Past-month forecasts are excluded because that spend is already reflected in job-to-date costs. Null when the project has no planned amount.

parent_monthly_forecasts.description: The parent project's forecast by month, keyed `YYYY-MM`, as decimal amounts in the company currency. Returned for every live project so the grid can apply an automated-curve re-spread without a reload; manual and no-curve forecasts come back as stored.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Procore-Company-Id': "SOME_STRING_VALUE" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/capital_planning/projects/%7Bprocore_project_id%7D/line_items?snapshot_id=SOME_STRING_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
